description: This file defines the ApiCallAttemptMonitoringMiddleware class, which is part of the AWS PHP SDK. It provides middleware functionality for monitoring API call attempts, capturing request and response data, handling different result types, and augmenting event data with metrics.

classes.name: ApiCallAttemptMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: This class extends AbstractMonitoringMiddleware to implement middleware that monitors AWS API call attempts, capturing request and response metrics, and handling various result and exception types.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper that incorporates CSM options and returns a handler.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Extracts and returns request data such as the FQDN from a RequestInterface object.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Processes result or exception objects to extract relevant monitoring data, including latency, status, headers, and error information.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Populates the request event data with the type 'ApiCallAttempt'.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Augments the event data with credentials info, attempt latency, and other metrics after an API call.
